sql: SELECT toQuarter(q.DateKey) AS Quarter, toYear(q.DateKey) AS Year, sum(q.SalesAmountQuota) AS ForecastAmount, sum(a.SalesAmount) AS ActualAmount, sum(a.SalesAmount) - sum(q.SalesAmountQuota) AS Variance, (sum(a.SalesAmount) - sum(q.SalesAmountQuota)) / sum(q.SalesAmountQuota) * 100 AS VariancePercent, sum(a.SalesAmount) / sum(q.SalesAmountQuota) * 100 AS AccuracyPercent FROM (SELECT DateKey, sum(SalesAmountQuota) AS SalesAmountQuota FROM retail.FactSalesQuota WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009 AND toQuarter(DateKey) = 4 GROUP BY DateKey) q LEFT JOIN (SELECT DateKey, sum(SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount FROM retail.FactSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009 AND toQuarter(DateKey) = 4 GROUP BY DateKey) a ON q.DateKey = a.DateKey GROUP BY Year, Quarter
